kurz: First the mushrooms must get rid of their water and brown, then reduced cream binds everything into a rich sauce.
bild_im_kopf: Like wet laundry before ironing: only once the water is out does it take on shape and sheen.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fry the mushrooms in a large hot pan without crowding
schluesselmomente.warum: First water runs out. Only once it has evaporated do they start to brown.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Salt only once they have browned
schluesselmomente.warum: Salt draws out water and delays browning.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add shallots, deglaze with white wine
schluesselmomente.warum: The wine dissolves the brown residue from the bottom of the pan.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Pour in cream and reduce until the sauce coats a spoon
schluesselmomente.warum: As the water evaporates, the cream thickens and gains flavour.
